# data-grid API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Controlled row presentation with suite-owned typed columns and native Fluent grid interactions.

## createDataGrid

Create an isolated typed grid and sixteen inferred JSX/builder column kinds.
Call once outside rendering. Descriptor and JSX columns must belong to this
suite; inputs and callbacks are immutable and pure. The native div ref follows
Fluent's grid and detaches while an empty/no-visible-column status is shown.
Sorting reports controlled intent without changing supplied item order.
Requires the Fluent UI/Charts host peers and shared FluentProvider/renderer; no SPFx provider is required.

### Imports

```ts
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/data-grid';
```

### Use when

- A known row model should infer field, accessor and presentation callback types across one isolated column suite.

### Avoid when

- Use the dynamic DataGrid only when a static row model cannot describe the input.

### Examples

#### Create a typed descriptor grid

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const Projects = createDataGrid<{ id:number; title:string }>();
const columns = Projects.defineColumns(c => [c.text({ id:'title', header:'Title', field:'title' })]);
<Projects items={[{ id:1, title:'Plan' }]} getRowId={row => row.id} columns={columns} />;
```

#### Explore typed document columns and controlled interaction

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, Field, Select, FluentProvider, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { CheckmarkCircle20Regular } from '@fluentui/react-icons';
import { createDataGrid, useSx, flex, gap, width } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface DemoPerson { readonly id: string; readonly name: string; }
interface DemoRow {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly total: number;
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  readonly day: string;
  readonly instant: string;
  readonly status: 'ready' | 'pending';
  readonly owner: DemoPerson;
  readonly people: readonly DemoPerson[];
  readonly tags: readonly ('design' | 'review' | 'release')[];
  readonly progress: number;
  readonly rating: number;
  readonly trend: readonly number[];
}

// A stable family outside rendering preserves descriptor and marker ownership.
const Grid = createDataGrid<DemoRow>();
const statusValues = { ready: { label: 'Ready', color: 'success' as const }, pending: { label: 'Pending', color: 'warning' as const } };
const iconValues = {
  ready: { label: 'Ready status', icon: <CheckmarkCircle20Regular /> },
  pending: { label: 'Pending status', icon: <CheckmarkCircle20Regular /> },
};
const tagValues = { design: { label: 'Design' }, review: { label: 'Review' }, release: { label: 'Release' } };
const initialRows: readonly DemoRow[] = [
  { id: 'a', title: 'Quarterly report', total: 12.5, enabled: true, day: '2024-02-29', instant: '2024-02-29T10:30:00Z', status: 'ready', owner: { id: 'alice', name: 'Alice Example' }, people: [{ id: 'alice', name: 'Alice Example' }, { id: 'bob', name: 'Bob Example' }, { id: 'carol', name: 'Carol Example' }], tags: ['design', 'review', 'release'], progress: 75, rating: 4, trend: [2, 4, 3, 7] },
  { id: 'b', title: 'Operations plan', total: 0, enabled: false, day: '0007-01-02', instant: '2024-03-01T09:00:00+01:00', status: 'pending', owner: { id: 'bob', name: 'Bob Example' }, people: [{ id: 'bob', name: 'Bob Example' }], tags: ['review'], progress: 0, rating: 2, trend: [-4, -2, -3, -1] },
];

const getRowId = (row: DemoRow): string => row.id;
const CustomCell: React.FC<{ rowId: string }> = ({ rowId }) => {
  const [clicks, setClicks] = React.useState(0);
  return <Button data-custom-row={rowId} onClick={() => setClicks(value => value + 1)}>Custom {clicks}</Button>;
};

type DemoRegions = { readonly controls?: React.ReactNode; readonly commands?: React.ReactNode; readonly status?: React.ReactNode; readonly diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; readonly children?: React.ReactNode };
type DemoProps = { readonly render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; readonly resetRevision?: number };
const useStyles = makeStyles({
  root: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' },
  actions: { display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' },
  scroll: { overflowX: 'auto', minWidth: 0 },
  frame: { maxInlineSize: '100%', minInlineSize: 0 },
});
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const sx = useSx(), styles = useStyles();
  const [dir, setDir] = React.useState<'host' | 'ltr' | 'rtl'>('host');
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(640);
  const [gridSize, setGridSize] = React.useState<'small' | 'medium' | 'extra-small'>('medium');
  const [selectionMode, setSelectionMode] = React.useState<'multiselect' | 'single' | undefined>('multiselect');
  const [rows, setRows] = React.useState(initialRows);
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<ReadonlySet<string | number>>(() => new Set(['off-page']));
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = React.useState(false);
  const [customStrings, setCustomStrings] = React.useState(false);
  const gridStrings = customStrings ? { selectAllRows: 'Select every document', selectRow: (id: string | number) => `Select document ${id}`, empty: 'No team documents', loading: 'Fetching documents' } : undefined;
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState(false);
  const [empty, setEmpty] = React.useState(false);
  const [emptyState, setEmptyState] = React.useState<'empty' | 'noResults'>('empty');
  const [resizable, setResizable] = React.useState(false);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState('Interact with the grid to observe selection and row identity.');
  const [activation, setActivation] = React.useState('none');
  const [retries, setRetries] = React.useState(0);
  const [observedRef, setObservedRef] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const [slotRefs, setSlotRefs] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const [suppressSlots, setSuppressSlots] = React.useState(false);
  const [customStatusSlots, setCustomStatusSlots] = React.useState(false);
  const errorSlotRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>(), []);
  const gridRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>(), []);
  const [sort, setSort] = React.useState<DataGridProps<DemoRow>['sortState']>();
  const [preset, setPreset] = React.useState<'overview' | 'dates' | 'team' | 'metrics' | 'custom'>('overview');
  const [alternateColor, setAlternateColor] = React.useState(false);
  const [action, setAction] = React.useState('none');
  const [navigation, setNavigation] = React.useState('none');
  const [slotClicks, setSlotClicks] = React.useState(0);
  const headerSlotRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLSpanElement>(), []);
  const previousReset = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (previousReset.current === resetRevision) return;
    previousReset.current = resetRevision;
    setDir('host'); setSize(640); setGridSize('medium'); setSelectionMode('multiselect');
    setRows(initialRows); setSelected(new Set(['off-page'])); setPage(false); setHidden(false); setCustomStrings(false);
    setLoading(false); setError(false); setEmpty(false); setEmptyState('empty'); setResizable(false);
    setOutcome('Interact with the grid to observe selection and row identity.'); setActivation('none'); setRetries(0);
    setObservedRef('not inspected'); setSlotRefs('not inspected'); setSuppressSlots(false); setCustomStatusSlots(false);
    setSort(undefined);
    setPreset('overview'); setAlternateColor(false); setAction('none'); setNavigation('none'); setSlotClicks(0);
  }, [resetRevision]);
  const visibleRows = empty ? [] : page ? rows.filter(row => row.id === 'a') : rows;
  const hiddenIds = hidden ? new Set(['title', 'total', 'enabled', 'day', 'instant', 'status', 'icon', 'link', 'owner', 'people', 'tags', 'progress', 'rating', 'trend', 'actions', 'custom']) : undefined;
  const applySort = (): void => {
    if (sort?.sortColumn !== 'title') return;
    const direction = sort.sortDirection === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1;
    setRows(previous => [...previous].sort((left, right) => direction * left.title.localeCompare(right.title)));
  };
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Columns"><Select data-demo-variant="Columns" id="dg-preset" value={preset} onChange={(_, data) => { if (data.value === 'overview' || data.value === 'dates' || data.value === 'team' || data.value === 'metrics' || data.value === 'custom') setPreset(data.value); }}><option value="overview">Documents</option><option value="dates">Dates and status</option><option value="team">People and tags</option><option value="metrics">Progress</option><option value="custom">Custom cells</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="Width"><Select id="dg-width" value={size} onChange={event => setSize(Number(event.target.value))}>{[320, 640, 1100].map(value => <option key={value} value={value}>{value}px</option>)}</Select></Field>
      <Field label="size"><Select id="dg-size" value={gridSize} onChange={event => { const value = event.target.value; if (value === 'small' || value === 'medium' || value === 'extra-small') setGridSize(value); }}><option value="extra-small">Extra small</option><option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="selectionMode"><Select id="dg-selection-mode" value={selectionMode ?? 'none'} onChange={event => setSelectionMode(event.target.value === 'single' ? 'single' : event.target.value === 'multiselect' ? 'multiselect' : undefined)}><option value="none">None</option><option value="single">Single</option><option value="multiselect">Multiselect</option></Select></Field>
    </>,
    commands: <div className={styles.actions} role="group" aria-label="Consumer simulation commands">
      <Button id="dg-apply-sort" onClick={applySort}>Apply sort intent</Button>
      <Button id="dg-reverse" onClick={() => setRows(previous => [...previous].reverse())}>Reverse supplied rows</Button>
      {preset === 'metrics' && <Button id="dg-update-sparkline" onClick={() => setRows(previous => previous.map(row => ({ ...row, trend: row.trend.map((value, index) => value + index * 3 + 1) })))}>Update chart observations</Button>}
    </div>,
    status: <p role="status">{outcome} Rows: {visibleRows.length}; selected: {selected.size}; retries: <output id="dg-retries">{retries}</output></p>,
    diagnostics: <>
      <Field label="Direction"><Select id="dg-dir" value={dir} onChange={event => setDir(event.target.value === 'rtl' ? 'rtl' : event.target.value === 'ltr' ? 'ltr' : 'host')}><option value="host">Host</option><option value="ltr">LTR</option><option value="rtl">RTL</option></Select></Field>
      <Checkbox id="dg-page" label="Supply first row only" checked={page} onChange={(_event, data) => setPage(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-hidden" label="Hide all columns" checked={hidden} onChange={(_event, data) => setHidden(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-strings" label="Custom UI strings (number/date locale stays en-US)" checked={customStrings} onChange={(_event, data) => setCustomStrings(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-loading" label="Loading" checked={loading} onChange={(_event, data) => setLoading(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-error" label="Error" checked={error} onChange={(_event, data) => setError(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-empty" label="Empty rows" checked={empty} onChange={(_event, data) => setEmpty(data.checked === true)} />
      <Field label="Empty presentation"><Select id="dg-empty-state" value={emptyState} onChange={event => setEmptyState(event.target.value === 'noResults' ? 'noResults' : 'empty')}><option value="empty">Empty</option><option value="noResults">No results</option></Select></Field>
      <Checkbox id="dg-resizable" label="Native resizing" checked={resizable} onChange={(_event, data) => setResizable(data.checked === true)} />
      {preset === 'metrics' && <Checkbox id="dg-color" label="Alternate chart color" checked={alternateColor} onChange={(_event, data) => setAlternateColor(data.checked === true)} />}
      <Checkbox id="dg-custom-status-slots" label="Custom empty and no-results slots" checked={customStatusSlots} onChange={(_event, data) => setCustomStatusSlots(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-slot-suppress" label="Suppress status and placeholder text" checked={suppressSlots} onChange={(_event, data) => setSuppressSlots(data.checked === true)} />
      <Button id="dg-inspect-slot-refs" onClick={() => setSlotRefs(`header=${headerSlotRef.current?.tagName ?? 'absent'} error=${errorSlotRef.current?.tagName ?? 'absent'}`)}>Inspect inner slot refs</Button>
      <Button id="dg-inspect-ref" onClick={() => setObservedRef(gridRef.current?.tagName.toLowerCase() ?? 'absent')}>Inspect native grid ref</Button>
      <p>Inner slot refs: <output id="dg-slot-refs">{slotRefs}</output></p>
      <p>Header slot callback clicks: <output id="dg-slot-clicks">{slotClicks}</output></p>
      <p>Selected IDs: <output id="dg-selection">{JSON.stringify(Array.from(selected))}</output></p>
      <p>Sort intent: <output id="dg-sort">{sort ? JSON.stringify({ columnId: sort.sortColumn, direction: sort.sortDirection }) : 'none'}</output></p>
      <p>Action: <output id="dg-action">{action}</output></p>
      <p>Navigation: <output id="dg-navigation">{navigation}</output></p>
      <p>Activation: <output id="dg-activation-output">{activation}</output></p>
      <p>Native ref: <output id="dg-ref">{observedRef}</output></p>
    </>,
    children: <div className={styles.scroll} role="region" aria-label="DataGrid preview scroll" tabIndex={0}>
      <div id="dg-frame" className={sx(flex.column, gap.large, width.px(size), styles.frame)}>
        <Grid id="data-grid-main" strings={gridStrings} ref={gridRef} aria-label="Team documents" items={visibleRows} getRowId={getRowId} locale="en-US"
          size={gridSize} selectionMode={selectionMode} selectedItems={selected} onSelectionChange={(_event, data) => { setSelected(new Set(data.selectedItems)); setOutcome(`Selection changed: ${data.selectedItems.size} selected`); }}
          sortState={sort} onSortChange={(_event, next) => { setSort(next); setOutcome(`Sort requested: ${next.sortColumn}, ${next.sortDirection}`); }}
          resizableColumns={resizable} hiddenColumnIds={hiddenIds} loading={loading} emptyState={emptyState}
          error={error ? { ref: errorSlotRef, children: <p>Consumer-owned loading error</p> } : undefined}
          emptyContent={suppressSlots ? false : customStatusSlots ? { children: 'Consumer-owned empty slot' } : undefined}
          noResultsContent={suppressSlots ? false : customStatusSlots ? { children: (Component, nativeProps) => <Component {...nativeProps}>Consumer-owned no-results slot</Component> } : undefined}
          onRowActivate={selectionMode === undefined ? (_event, data) => setActivation(JSON.stringify({ rowId: data.rowId })) : undefined}
          onRetry={() => { setRetries(value => value + 1); setError(false); }}>
              {["overview","dates","team","metrics","custom"].includes(preset) && <Grid.TextColumn id="title" header={{ ref: headerSlotRef, onClick: () => setSlotClicks(value => value + 1), children: (Component, nativeProps) => <Component {...nativeProps} data-grid-slot-callback="header">Title</Component> }} headerAriaLabel="Title" field="title" sortable width={160} minWidth={100} />}
              {["overview"].includes(preset) && <Grid.NumberColumn id="total" header="Total" field="total" format={{ minimumFractionDigits: 2 }} width={120} />}
              {["dates","custom"].includes(preset) && <Grid.BooleanColumn id="enabled" header="Enabled" field="enabled" display="icon" trueLabel="Enabled yes" falseLabel="Enabled no" width={110} />}
              {["dates"].includes(preset) && <Grid.DateColumn id="day" header="Calendar day" field="day" width={150} />}
              {["dates"].includes(preset) && <Grid.DateTimeColumn id="instant" header="Instant UTC" field="instant" width={180} />}
              {["overview"].includes(preset) && <Grid.BadgeColumn id="status" header="Status" field="status" values={statusValues} width={120} />}
              {["custom"].includes(preset) && <Grid.IconColumn id="icon" header="Status icon" field="status" values={iconValues} width={110} />}
              {["team"].includes(preset) && <Grid.LinkColumn id="link" header="Details" field="title" href={(row) => `#details-${row.id}`} onNavigate={(event, data) => { event.preventDefault(); setNavigation(JSON.stringify({ rowId: data.rowId, value: data.value, href: data.href })); }} width={140} />}
              {["overview","team"].includes(preset) && <Grid.PersonColumn id="owner" header="Owner" field="owner" getName={person => person.name} width={200} />}
              {["team"].includes(preset) && <Grid.PeopleColumn id="people" header="People" field="people" getName={person => person.name} getPersonId={person => person.id} maxVisible={1} width={160} />}
              {["team"].includes(preset) && <Grid.TagsColumn id="tags" header="Tags" field="tags" values={tagValues} maxVisible={1} width={160} />}
              {["metrics"].includes(preset) && <Grid.ProgressColumn id="progress" header="Progress" field="progress" max={100} format={{ style: 'percent' }} showValue width={150} />}
              {["metrics"].includes(preset) && <Grid.RatingColumn id="rating" header="Rating" field="rating" max={5} width={180} />}
              {["metrics"].includes(preset) && <Grid.SparklineColumn id="trend" header="Trend" field="trend" showValue color={alternateColor ? '#d13438' : '#107c10'} width={160} />}
              {["overview"].includes(preset) && <Grid.ActionsColumn id="actions" header="Actions" width={150} minWidth={120} actions={[
                { id: 'review', label: 'Open report', placement: 'inline', onClick: (_event, data) => { setAction(JSON.stringify({ rowId: data.rowId, actionId: data.actionId })); setOutcome(`${data.actionId}: ${data.rowId}`); } },
                { id: 'archive', label: 'Archive record', placement: 'menu', onClick: (_event, data) => { setAction(JSON.stringify({ rowId: data.rowId, actionId: data.actionId })); setOutcome(`${data.actionId}: ${data.rowId}`); } },
              ]} />}
              {["custom"].includes(preset) && <Grid.Column id="custom" header="Custom" field="title" renderCell={({ item }) => <CustomCell rowId={item.id} />} width={130} />}
        </Grid>
      </div>
    </div>,
  };
  return <FluentProvider dir={dir === 'host' ? undefined : dir}>
    <section id="data-grid-demo" className={styles.root}>
      {render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>}
    </section>
  </FluentProvider>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'none', kind: 'snapshot', contentPlacement: 'subject', observe: 'Switch all five column presets, apply controlled sort intent, select stable row IDs, activate rows and actions, then inspect native slots, Charts and retained custom state.' };
```

#### Supply descriptor columns with explicit sort and row order

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, Field, Select, FluentProvider, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { createDataGrid, useSx, flex, gap, width } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface DemoRow { readonly id: string; readonly title: string; readonly total: number; readonly enabled: boolean; readonly day: string; }
const Grid = createDataGrid<DemoRow>();
const initialRows: readonly DemoRow[] = [
  { id: 'a', title: 'Quarterly report', total: 12.5, enabled: true, day: '2024-02-29' },
  { id: 'b', title: 'Operations plan', total: 0, enabled: false, day: '0007-01-02' },
];
const getRowId = (row: DemoRow): string => row.id;
const descriptorColumns = Grid.defineColumns(c => [
  c.text({ id: 'title', header: 'Title', field: 'title', sortable: true, width: 180, minWidth: 100 }),
  c.number({ id: 'total', header: 'Total', field: 'total', width: 120 }),
  c.boolean({ id: 'enabled', header: 'Enabled', field: 'enabled', width: 100 }),
  c.date({ id: 'day', header: 'Date', field: 'day', width: 140 }),
]);
type DemoRegions = { readonly controls?: React.ReactNode; readonly commands?: React.ReactNode; readonly status?: React.ReactNode; readonly diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; readonly children?: React.ReactNode };
type DemoProps = { readonly render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; readonly resetRevision?: number };
const useStyles = makeStyles({
  root: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' },
  actions: { display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' },
  scroll: { overflowX: 'auto', minWidth: 0 },
  frame: { maxInlineSize: '100%', minInlineSize: 0 },
});
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const sx = useSx(), styles = useStyles();
  const [dir, setDir] = React.useState<'host' | 'ltr' | 'rtl'>('host');
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(640);
  const [gridSize, setGridSize] = React.useState<'small' | 'medium' | 'extra-small'>('medium');
  const [selectionMode, setSelectionMode] = React.useState<'multiselect' | 'single' | undefined>('multiselect');
  const [rows, setRows] = React.useState(initialRows);
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<ReadonlySet<string | number>>(() => new Set(['off-page']));
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = React.useState(false);
  const [customStrings, setCustomStrings] = React.useState(false);
  const gridStrings = customStrings ? { selectAllRows: 'Select every document', selectRow: (id: string | number) => `Select document ${id}`, empty: 'No team documents', loading: 'Fetching documents' } : undefined;
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState(false);
  const [empty, setEmpty] = React.useState(false);
  const [emptyState, setEmptyState] = React.useState<'empty' | 'noResults'>('empty');
  const [resizable, setResizable] = React.useState(false);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState('Interact with the grid to observe selection and row identity.');
  const [activation, setActivation] = React.useState('none');
  const [retries, setRetries] = React.useState(0);
  const [observedRef, setObservedRef] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const [slotRefs, setSlotRefs] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const [suppressSlots, setSuppressSlots] = React.useState(false);
  const [customStatusSlots, setCustomStatusSlots] = React.useState(false);
  const errorSlotRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>(), []);
  const gridRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>(), []);
  const [sort, setSort] = React.useState<DataGridProps<DemoRow>['sortState']>();
  const previousReset = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (previousReset.current === resetRevision) return;
    previousReset.current = resetRevision;
    setDir('host'); setSize(640); setGridSize('medium'); setSelectionMode('multiselect');
    setRows(initialRows); setSelected(new Set(['off-page'])); setPage(false); setHidden(false); setCustomStrings(false);
    setLoading(false); setError(false); setEmpty(false); setEmptyState('empty'); setResizable(false);
    setOutcome('Interact with the grid to observe selection and row identity.'); setActivation('none'); setRetries(0);
    setObservedRef('not inspected'); setSlotRefs('not inspected'); setSuppressSlots(false); setCustomStatusSlots(false);
    setSort(undefined);
  }, [resetRevision]);
  const visibleRows = empty ? [] : page ? rows.filter(row => row.id === 'a') : rows;
  const hiddenIds = hidden ? new Set(['title', 'total', 'enabled', 'day']) : undefined;
  const applySort = (): void => {
    if (sort?.sortColumn !== 'title') return;
    const direction = sort.sortDirection === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1;
    setRows(previous => [...previous].sort((left, right) => direction * left.title.localeCompare(right.title)));
  };
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Width"><Select id="dg-width" value={size} onChange={event => setSize(Number(event.target.value))}>{[320, 640, 1100].map(value => <option key={value} value={value}>{value}px</option>)}</Select></Field>
      <Field label="size"><Select id="dg-size" value={gridSize} onChange={event => { const value = event.target.value; if (value === 'small' || value === 'medium' || value === 'extra-small') setGridSize(value); }}><option value="extra-small">Extra small</option><option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="selectionMode"><Select id="dg-selection-mode" value={selectionMode ?? 'none'} onChange={event => setSelectionMode(event.target.value === 'single' ? 'single' : event.target.value === 'multiselect' ? 'multiselect' : undefined)}><option value="none">None</option><option value="single">Single</option><option value="multiselect">Multiselect</option></Select></Field>
    </>,
    commands: <div className={styles.actions} role="group" aria-label="Consumer simulation commands">
      <Button id="dg-apply-sort" onClick={applySort}>Apply sort intent</Button>
      <Button id="dg-reverse" onClick={() => setRows(previous => [...previous].reverse())}>Reverse supplied rows</Button>
    </div>,
    status: <p role="status">{outcome} Rows: {visibleRows.length}; selected: {selected.size}; retries: <output id="dg-retries">{retries}</output></p>,
    diagnostics: <>
      <Field label="Direction"><Select id="dg-dir" value={dir} onChange={event => setDir(event.target.value === 'rtl' ? 'rtl' : event.target.value === 'ltr' ? 'ltr' : 'host')}><option value="host">Host</option><option value="ltr">LTR</option><option value="rtl">RTL</option></Select></Field>
      <Checkbox id="dg-page" label="Supply first row only" checked={page} onChange={(_event, data) => setPage(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-hidden" label="Hide all columns" checked={hidden} onChange={(_event, data) => setHidden(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-strings" label="Custom UI strings (number/date locale stays en-US)" checked={customStrings} onChange={(_event, data) => setCustomStrings(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-loading" label="Loading" checked={loading} onChange={(_event, data) => setLoading(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-error" label="Error" checked={error} onChange={(_event, data) => setError(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-empty" label="Empty rows" checked={empty} onChange={(_event, data) => setEmpty(data.checked === true)} />
      <Field label="Empty presentation"><Select id="dg-empty-state" value={emptyState} onChange={event => setEmptyState(event.target.value === 'noResults' ? 'noResults' : 'empty')}><option value="empty">Empty</option><option value="noResults">No results</option></Select></Field>
      <Checkbox id="dg-resizable" label="Native resizing" checked={resizable} onChange={(_event, data) => setResizable(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-custom-status-slots" label="Custom empty and no-results slots" checked={customStatusSlots} onChange={(_event, data) => setCustomStatusSlots(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-slot-suppress" label="Suppress status and placeholder text" checked={suppressSlots} onChange={(_event, data) => setSuppressSlots(data.checked === true)} />
      <Button id="dg-inspect-slot-refs" onClick={() => setSlotRefs(`error=${errorSlotRef.current?.tagName ?? 'absent'}`)}>Inspect inner slot refs</Button>
      <Button id="dg-inspect-ref" onClick={() => setObservedRef(gridRef.current?.tagName.toLowerCase() ?? 'absent')}>Inspect native grid ref</Button>
      <p>Inner slot refs: <output id="dg-slot-refs">{slotRefs}</output></p>
      <p>Selected IDs: <output id="dg-selection">{JSON.stringify(Array.from(selected))}</output></p>
      <p>Sort intent: <output id="dg-sort">{sort ? JSON.stringify({ columnId: sort.sortColumn, direction: sort.sortDirection }) : 'none'}</output></p>
      <p>Activation: <output id="dg-activation-output">{activation}</output></p>
      <p>Native ref: <output id="dg-ref">{observedRef}</output></p>
    </>,
    children: <div className={styles.scroll} role="region" aria-label="DataGrid preview scroll" tabIndex={0}>
      <div id="dg-frame" className={sx(flex.column, gap.large, width.px(size), styles.frame)}>
        <Grid id="data-grid-main" strings={gridStrings} ref={gridRef} aria-label="Team documents" items={visibleRows} getRowId={getRowId} locale="en-US"
          size={gridSize} selectionMode={selectionMode} selectedItems={selected} onSelectionChange={(_event, data) => { setSelected(new Set(data.selectedItems)); setOutcome(`Selection changed: ${data.selectedItems.size} selected`); }}
          sortState={sort} onSortChange={(_event, next) => { setSort(next); setOutcome(`Sort requested: ${next.sortColumn}, ${next.sortDirection}`); }}
          resizableColumns={resizable} hiddenColumnIds={hiddenIds} loading={loading} emptyState={emptyState}
          error={error ? { ref: errorSlotRef, children: <p>Consumer-owned loading error</p> } : undefined}
          emptyContent={suppressSlots ? false : customStatusSlots ? { children: 'Consumer-owned empty slot' } : undefined}
          noResultsContent={suppressSlots ? false : customStatusSlots ? { children: (Component, nativeProps) => <Component {...nativeProps}>Consumer-owned no-results slot</Component> } : undefined}
          onRowActivate={selectionMode === undefined ? (_event, data) => setActivation(JSON.stringify({ rowId: data.rowId })) : undefined}
          onRetry={() => { setRetries(value => value + 1); setError(false); }} columns={descriptorColumns} />
      </div>
    </div>,
  };
  return <FluentProvider dir={dir === 'host' ? undefined : dir}>
    <section id="data-grid-demo" className={styles.root}>
      {render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>}
    </section>
  </FluentProvider>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'none', kind: 'snapshot', contentPlacement: 'subject', observe: 'Request sort without changing supplied order, explicitly apply or reverse rows, retain off-page selection, and inspect native status, sizing and ref boundaries.' };
```

Actions deliberately have no source or sorting option.

### Type parameters (2)

### Type (2)

````ts
type ActionsColumnProps<TItem> = Omit<DataGridColumnCommonProps<TItem, undefined>, 'header' | 'sortable'> & {
    /**
     * Optional literal actions heading; defaults to the localized label only when
     * undefined. Object/callback slots use a fixed inner span; refs target it.
     * Supply phrasing, noninteractive content.
     * @example
     * ```ts
     * import { DataGridColumnCommonProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
     * const header: DataGridColumnCommonProps<{ title: string }, string>['header'] = { children: 'Actions' };
     * ```
     */
    header?: ContentSlot<'span'>;
    /**
     * Ordered synchronous actions evaluated for the original row.
     */
    actions: readonly DataGridAction<TItem>[];
    /**
     * Actions cannot read a field.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    field?: never;
    /**
     * Actions cannot read an accessor.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    accessor?: never;
}
````

| `ActionsColumnProps.field` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Actions cannot read a field.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `ActionsColumnProps.header` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional literal actions heading; defaults to the localized label only when<br>undefined. Object/callback slots use a fixed inner span; refs target it.<br>Supply phrasing, noninteractive content. |
| `ActionsColumnProps.headerAriaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | See [DataGridColumnCommonProps.headerAriaLabel](data-grid.md#datagridcolumncommonprops) | Accessible name for a non-text header.<br>When omitted, no explicit accessible-name override is added; provide meaningful header content. Inherited from [DataGridColumnCommonProps.headerAriaLabel](data-grid.md#datagridcolumncommonprops). |
| `ActionsColumnProps.headerTooltip` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | See [DataGridColumnCommonProps.headerTooltip](data-grid.md#datagridcolumncommonprops) | Plain-text header description.<br>When omitted, no separate header description is configured. Inherited from [DataGridColumnCommonProps.headerTooltip](data-grid.md#datagridcolumncommonprops). |

Inherited from [DataGridColumnCommonProps.placeholder](data-grid.md#datagridcolumncommonprops). |

## CompatibleDataGridField

Field names whose non-nullish domain is compatible with a column.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (4)

```ts
import { DataGridValueSource } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
type NumericField = DataGridValueSource<{ name: string; total: number }, number>['field'];
const field: NumericField = 'total';
```

### Type parameters (3)

- `TItem`: Original row model passed unchanged to sources and callbacks.
- `TValue`: Source value domain used to restrict fields and preserve callback value types.

### Type (3)

```ts
type CompatibleDataGridField<TItem, TValue> = {
    [K in Extract<keyof TItem, string>]:
        [NonNullable<TItem[K]>] extends [never] ? never :
        NonNullable<TItem[K]> extends TValue ? K : never;
}[Extract<keyof TItem, string>]

### Type (11)

```ts
type DataGridColumnOptions<TItem, K extends keyof DataGridColumnDomains, V> = K extends 'number' ? DataGridNumberOptions :

    K extends 'date' | 'dateTime' ? DataGridDateOptions :
    K extends 'badge' ? DataGridBadgeOptions<V> :
    K extends 'icon' ? DataGridIconOptions<V> :
    K extends 'link' ? DataGridLinkOptions<TItem> :
    K extends 'person' ? DataGridPersonOptions<TItem, V> :
    K extends 'people' ? DataGridPeopleOptions<TItem, ElementOf<V>> :
    K extends 'tags' ? DataGridTagsOptions<TItem, ElementOf<V>> :
    K extends 'progress' ? DataGridProgressOptions :
    K extends 'rating' ? DataGridRatingOptions<TItem> :
    K extends 'sparkline' ? DataGridSparklineOptions<TItem> :
    K extends 'custom' ? DataGridCustomOptions<TItem, V> : object
```

## DataGridLinkOptions.onNavigate

Called on anchor activation with the original row, ID, valid text and resolved destination.
Row propagation is stopped; call event.preventDefault() to replace native navigation. Return values/promises are not observed.
When omitted, activation follows native anchor navigation without a consumer callback.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

```

## DataGridTagsOptions

Exact tag mappings or paired callbacks for scalar or object tags.
Missing configuration and incomplete callback pairs are rejected by types and runtime.

### Imports (32)

```ts
import type { DataGridTagsOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DataGridTagsOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { DataGridTagsOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/data-grid';
```

### Examples (56)

```ts
import { DataGridTagsOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const options: DataGridTagsOptions<{ id: number }, { id: string; label: string }> = {
  getTagId: tag => tag.id, getLabel: tag => tag.label, maxVisible: 3,
};
```

### Type parameters (22)

- `TItem`: Original row model passed unchanged to sources and callbacks.
- `TTag`: Original tag element passed to identity and label callbacks.

### Type (27)

```ts
type DataGridTagsOptions<TItem, TTag> = {
    /**
     * Positive whole-number maximum visible tags before recoverable overflow. When omitted, shows every tag.
     */
    maxVisible?: number;
} & ({
    /**
     * Exact scalar IDs mapped to Fluent presentations; numeric keys require a Map.
     */
    values: DataGridTagValues<TTag>;
    /**
     * Excluded when using scalar map identities.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    getTagId?: never;
    /**
     * Labels are supplied by the map.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    getLabel?: never;
} | {
    /**
     * Optional mapped presentation for IDs returned by getTagId.
     * When omitted in the callback branch, getLabel supplies the tag text and native tag presentation is retained.
     */
    values?: DataGridTagValues<TTag>;
    /**
     * Stable scalar ID for each tag. Supply with getLabel; without a mapping,
     * callbacks also read scalar tags. With a mapping, scalar IDs stay original.
     * @param item - Original row object, unchanged from the supplied items array.
     * @param tag - Original tag element from this row’s source array.
     * @returns Stable string or finite numeric identity, unique within the relevant row/element collection.
     */
    getTagId: (tag: TTag, item: TItem) => DataGridRowId;
    /**
     * Explicit tag label. Supply with getTagId. Mapped labels take precedence;
     * scalar tags use these callbacks when no mapping is declared.
     * @param item - Original row object, unchanged from the supplied items array.
     * @param tag - Original tag element from this row’s source array.
     * @returns Plain display and accessible name for the original source element.
     */
    getLabel: (tag: TTag, item: TItem) => string;
})
```

### Type (30)

```ts
type DataGridValueSource<TItem, TValue> = {
    /**
     * Compatible top-level field; mutually exclusive with accessor.
     */
    field: CompatibleDataGridField<TItem, TValue>;
    /**
     * Excluded for field-backed sources.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    accessor?: never;
} | {
    /**
     * Excluded for computed sources.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    field?: never;
    /**
     * Pure synchronous source returning original values.
     * @param item - Original row object, unchanged from the supplied items array.
     * @returns Original synchronous source value, or undefined/legacy null for a missing cell.
     */
    accessor: (item: TItem) => DataGridSourceResult<TValue>;
}
```

### Type parameters (26)

- `K`: Column kind selecting the compatible source domain and presentation options.

### Type (31)

```ts
type DynamicDataGridColumnProps<K extends keyof DataGridColumnDomains> = DataGridColumnCommonProps<Record<string, unknown>, unknown> & ({
    /**
     * Explicit dynamic top-level field.
     */
    field: string;
    /**
     * Excluded for field sources.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    accessor?: never;
} | {
    /**
     * Excluded for computed sources.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    field?: never;
    /**
     * Pure synchronous source; its return remains unknown.
     * @param item - Original row object, unchanged from the supplied items array.
     * @returns Original synchronous source value, or undefined/legacy null for a missing cell.
     */
    accessor: (item: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown;
}) & DataGridColumnOptions<Record<string, unknown>, K, unknown>
```

## FieldProps

Field-backed column configuration retaining the exact selected property domain.
TItem is the row, K selects presentation, and F is the compatible top-level field.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (94)

```ts
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const Grid = createDataGrid<{ total: number }>();
const columns = Grid.defineColumns(c => [
  c.number({ id: 'total', header: 'Total', field: 'total' }),
]);
```

### Type parameters (27)

- `F`: Compatible top-level field name whose property type drives callback inference.
- `K`: Column kind selecting the compatible source domain and presentation options.
- `TItem`: Original row model passed unchanged to sources and callbacks.

### Type (32)

```ts
type FieldProps<TItem, K extends keyof DataGridColumnDomains, F extends Extract<keyof TItem, string>> = DataGridColumnCommonProps<TItem, TItem[F]> & {
    /**
     * Compatible original row field used as the source.
     */
    field: F;
    /**
     * Excluded for field-backed columns.
     * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
     */
    accessor?: never;
} & DataGridColumnOptions<TItem, K, NonNullable<TItem[F]>>
```

## SourceOnly

TS 5.3 inference fence: only the source selects the value domain, not mappings or presentation callbacks.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (97)

```ts
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const Grid = createDataGrid<{ total: number }>();
const columns = Grid.defineColumns(c => [c.number({ id: 'total', header: 'Total', field: 'total' })]);
```

### Type parameters (33)

- `T`: Source-inferred type prevented from widening through presentation callbacks.

### Type (35)

```ts
type SourceOnly<T> = [T][T extends unknown ? 0 : never]
```

### Source (86)

[packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/data-grid/data-grid-column.types.ts:1123](https://github.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/blob/main/packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/data-grid/data-grid-column.types.ts#L1123)

## DataGrid

Native controlled grid for dictionary rows. Values remain unknown until classified.
Requires immutable items, stable getRowId and one same-suite column collection.
Native div ref is unavailable while a status replaces the grid. Fluent supplies
navigation, resize, selection and cell widgets; no SPFx provider is required.

### Imports (38)

```ts
import { DataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { DataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { DataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/data-grid';
```

### Use when (2)

- Rows are dynamic records and column callbacks can explicitly handle unknown values.

### Avoid when (2)

- Use createDataGrid for a known row model to preserve inferred source domains.

### Examples (98)

#### Render a dynamic title column

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { DataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const rows = [{ id: 1, title: 'Plan' }];
<DataGrid items={rows} getRowId={row => String(row.id)}><DataGrid.TextColumn id="title" header="Title" field="title" /></DataGrid>
```

#### Classify dynamic row values and preserve controlled selection

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, Field, Select, FluentProvider, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { DataGrid, useSx, flex, gap, width } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const initialRows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] = [
  { id: 'valid', text: '', number: 0, enabled: false },
  { id: 'missing' },
  { id: 'invalid', text: { unsafe: 'object' }, number: '42', enabled: 'yes' },
];
const getRowId = (row: Record<string, unknown>): string => String(row.id);
type DemoRegions = { readonly controls?: React.ReactNode; readonly commands?: React.ReactNode; readonly status?: React.ReactNode; readonly diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; readonly children?: React.ReactNode };
type DemoProps = { readonly render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; readonly resetRevision?: number };
const useStyles = makeStyles({
  root: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' },
  actions: { display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' },
  scroll: { overflowX: 'auto', minWidth: 0 },
  frame: { maxInlineSize: '100%', minInlineSize: 0 },
});
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const sx = useSx(), styles = useStyles();
  const [dir, setDir] = React.useState<'host' | 'ltr' | 'rtl'>('host');
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(640);
  const [gridSize, setGridSize] = React.useState<'small' | 'medium' | 'extra-small'>('medium');
  const [selectionMode, setSelectionMode] = React.useState<'multiselect' | 'single' | undefined>('multiselect');
  const [rows, setRows] = React.useState(initialRows);
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<ReadonlySet<string | number>>(() => new Set(['off-page']));
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = React.useState(false);
  const [customStrings, setCustomStrings] = React.useState(false);
  const gridStrings = customStrings ? { selectAllRows: 'Select every document', selectRow: (id: string | number) => `Select document ${id}`, empty: 'No team documents', loading: 'Fetching documents' } : undefined;
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState(false);
  const [empty, setEmpty] = React.useState(false);
  const [emptyState, setEmptyState] = React.useState<'empty' | 'noResults'>('empty');
  const [resizable, setResizable] = React.useState(false);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState('Interact with the grid to observe selection and row identity.');
  const [activation, setActivation] = React.useState('none');
  const [retries, setRetries] = React.useState(0);
  const [observedRef, setObservedRef] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const [slotRefs, setSlotRefs] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const [suppressSlots, setSuppressSlots] = React.useState(false);
  const [customStatusSlots, setCustomStatusSlots] = React.useState(false);
  const errorSlotRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>(), []);
  const gridRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>(), []);
  const placeholderSlotRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLSpanElement>(), []);
  const previousReset = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (previousReset.current === resetRevision) return;
    previousReset.current = resetRevision;
    setDir('host'); setSize(640); setGridSize('medium'); setSelectionMode('multiselect');
    setRows(initialRows); setSelected(new Set(['off-page'])); setPage(false); setHidden(false); setCustomStrings(false);
    setLoading(false); setError(false); setEmpty(false); setEmptyState('empty'); setResizable(false);
    setOutcome('Interact with the grid to observe selection and row identity.'); setActivation('none'); setRetries(0);
    setObservedRef('not inspected'); setSlotRefs('not inspected'); setSuppressSlots(false); setCustomStatusSlots(false);
  }, [resetRevision]);
  const visibleRows = empty ? [] : page ? rows.filter(row => row.id === 'valid') : rows;
  const hiddenIds = hidden ? new Set(['text', 'number', 'enabled', 'status']) : undefined;
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Width"><Select id="dg-width" value={size} onChange={event => setSize(Number(event.target.value))}>{[320, 640, 1100].map(value => <option key={value} value={value}>{value}px</option>)}</Select></Field>
      <Field label="size"><Select id="dg-size" value={gridSize} onChange={event => { const value = event.target.value; if (value === 'small' || value === 'medium' || value === 'extra-small') setGridSize(value); }}><option value="extra-small">Extra small</option><option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="selectionMode"><Select id="dg-selection-mode" value={selectionMode ?? 'none'} onChange={event => setSelectionMode(event.target.value === 'single' ? 'single' : event.target.value === 'multiselect' ? 'multiselect' : undefined)}><option value="none">None</option><option value="single">Single</option><option value="multiselect">Multiselect</option></Select></Field>
    </>,
    commands: <div className={styles.actions} role="group" aria-label="Consumer simulation commands">
      <Button id="dg-reverse" onClick={() => setRows(previous => [...previous].reverse())}>Reverse supplied rows</Button>
    </div>,
    status: <p role="status">{outcome} Rows: {visibleRows.length}; selected: {selected.size}; retries: <output id="dg-retries">{retries}</output></p>,
    diagnostics: <>
      <Field label="Direction"><Select id="dg-dir" value={dir} onChange={event => setDir(event.target.value === 'rtl' ? 'rtl' : event.target.value === 'ltr' ? 'ltr' : 'host')}><option value="host">Host</option><option value="ltr">LTR</option><option value="rtl">RTL</option></Select></Field>
      <Checkbox id="dg-page" label="Supply first row only" checked={page} onChange={(_event, data) => setPage(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-hidden" label="Hide all columns" checked={hidden} onChange={(_event, data) => setHidden(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-strings" label="Custom UI strings (number/date locale stays en-US)" checked={customStrings} onChange={(_event, data) => setCustomStrings(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-loading" label="Loading" checked={loading} onChange={(_event, data) => setLoading(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-error" label="Error" checked={error} onChange={(_event, data) => setError(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-empty" label="Empty rows" checked={empty} onChange={(_event, data) => setEmpty(data.checked === true)} />
      <Field label="Empty presentation"><Select id="dg-empty-state" value={emptyState} onChange={event => setEmptyState(event.target.value === 'noResults' ? 'noResults' : 'empty')}><option value="empty">Empty</option><option value="noResults">No results</option></Select></Field>
      <Checkbox id="dg-resizable" label="Native resizing" checked={resizable} onChange={(_event, data) => setResizable(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-custom-status-slots" label="Custom empty and no-results slots" checked={customStatusSlots} onChange={(_event, data) => setCustomStatusSlots(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox id="dg-slot-suppress" label="Suppress status and placeholder text" checked={suppressSlots} onChange={(_event, data) => setSuppressSlots(data.checked === true)} />
      <Button id="dg-inspect-slot-refs" onClick={() => setSlotRefs(`error=${errorSlotRef.current?.tagName ?? 'absent'} missing=${placeholderSlotRef.current?.tagName ?? 'absent'}`)}>Inspect inner slot refs</Button>
      <Button id="dg-inspect-ref" onClick={() => setObservedRef(gridRef.current?.tagName.toLowerCase() ?? 'absent')}>Inspect native grid ref</Button>
      <p>Inner slot refs: <output id="dg-slot-refs">{slotRefs}</output></p>
      <p>Selected IDs: <output id="dg-selection">{JSON.stringify(Array.from(selected))}</output></p>
      <p>Activation: <output id="dg-activation-output">{activation}</output></p>
      <p>Native ref: <output id="dg-ref">{observedRef}</output></p>
    </>,
    children: <div className={styles.scroll} role="region" aria-label="DataGrid preview scroll" tabIndex={0}>
      <div id="dg-frame" className={sx(flex.column, gap.large, width.px(size), styles.frame)}>
        <DataGrid id="data-grid-main" strings={gridStrings} ref={gridRef} aria-label="Dynamic data" items={visibleRows} getRowId={getRowId} locale="en-US"
          size={gridSize} selectionMode={selectionMode} selectedItems={selected} onSelectionChange={(_event, data) => { setSelected(new Set(data.selectedItems)); setOutcome(`Selection changed: ${data.selectedItems.size} selected`); }}
          resizableColumns={resizable} hiddenColumnIds={hiddenIds} loading={loading} emptyState={emptyState}
          error={error ? { ref: errorSlotRef, children: <p>Consumer-owned loading error</p> } : undefined}
          emptyContent={suppressSlots ? false : customStatusSlots ? { children: 'Consumer-owned empty slot' } : undefined}
          noResultsContent={suppressSlots ? false : customStatusSlots ? { children: (Component, nativeProps) => <Component {...nativeProps}>Consumer-owned no-results slot</Component> } : undefined}
          onRowActivate={selectionMode === undefined ? (_event, data) => setActivation(JSON.stringify({ rowId: data.rowId })) : undefined}
          onRetry={() => { setRetries(value => value + 1); setError(false); }}>
          <DataGrid.TextColumn id="text" header="Title" field="text" placeholder={suppressSlots ? false : { ref: placeholderSlotRef, children: 'Missing text' }} invalidPlaceholder="Invalid text" />
          <DataGrid.NumberColumn id="number" header="Total" field="number" placeholder={suppressSlots ? false : 'Missing number'} invalidPlaceholder="Invalid number" />
          <DataGrid.BooleanColumn id="enabled" header="Enabled" field="enabled" placeholder={suppressSlots ? false : undefined} />
          <DataGrid.TextColumn id="status" header="Status" field="status" placeholder={suppressSlots ? false : 'Missing status'} />
        </DataGrid>
      </div>
    </div>,
  };
  return <FluentProvider dir={dir === 'host' ? undefined : dir}>
    <section id="data-grid-demo" className={styles.root}>
      {render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>}
    </section>
  </FluentProvider>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'none', kind: 'snapshot', contentPlacement: 'subject', observe: 'Compare valid empty text, zero and false with missing and invalid values, then select or activate original IDs and inspect native status and placeholder refs.' };
```

### Type (36)

```ts
type DataGridColumnCollection<TItem extends object> = {
    /**
     * Same-suite descriptors, including an explicitly empty list.
     */
    columns: readonly DataGridColumnDefinition<TItem>[];
    /**
     * Excluded when descriptors are provided.
     * Must be omitted entirely in this branch. An own children key, including
     * children: undefined, conflicts with columns and throws at runtime.
     */
    children?: never;
} | {
    /**
     * Same-suite JSX markers, including an explicitly empty collection.
     */
    children: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Excluded when JSX is declared.
     * Must be omitted entirely in this branch. An own columns key, including
     * columns: undefined, conflicts with children and throws at runtime.
     */
    columns?: never;
}
```

## DataGridProps

Controlled grid configuration. Input order is preserved.

### Imports (41)

```ts
import type { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/data-grid';
```

### Examples (118)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const Grid = createDataGrid<{ id: number; title: string }>();
const rows = [{ id: 1, title: 'Plan' }];
const columns = Grid.defineColumns(c => [c.text({ id: 'title', header: 'Title', field: 'title' })]);
<Grid items={rows} getRowId={row => row.id} columns={columns} />
```

### Type parameters (36)

- `TItem`: Original row model passed unchanged to sources and callbacks.

### Type (38)

````ts
type DataGridProps<TItem extends object> = Omit<
    FluentDataGridProps,
    keyof React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
    | 'items' | 'getRowId' | 'columns' | 'children'
    | 'sortState' | 'defaultSortState' | 'onSortChange'
    | 'selectedItems' | 'defaultSelectedItems' | 'onSelectionChange'
    | 'selectionMode' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' | 'onClick'
    | 'as' | 'noNativeElements' | 'sortable' | 'columnSizingOptions' | 'containerWidthOffset'
> & Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML'>
& DataGridColumnCollection<TItem> & {
    /**
     * Immutable source rows; objects are passed to callbacks unchanged.
     */
    items: readonly TItem[];
    /**
     * Native div click event.
     * When omitted, no consumer root-click handler is attached.
     */
    onClick?: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLDivElement>;
    /**
     * Synchronously returns a stable finite number or string ID unique across supplied rows. Never inferred from position; duplicate/invalid IDs throw.
     * @param item - Original row object, unchanged from the supplied items array.
     * @returns Stable string or finite numeric identity, unique within the relevant row/element collection.
     */
    getRowId: (item: TItem) => DataGridRowId;
    /**
     * Controlled sort intent; rows are not sorted internally. Omitted, stale, hidden or non-sortable column intent is inactive.
     */
    sortState?: FluentDataGridProps['sortState'];
    /**
     * Native Fluent sort intent notification with event and proposed sort state. Update sortState and item ordering externally; return values are ignored.
     * When omitted, no consumer receives sort requests; supplied rows and controlled sort state remain unchanged.
     */
    onSortChange?: FluentDataGridProps['onSortChange'];
    /**
     * Enables native single or multiselect intent; when omitted, disables selection. Mutually exclusive with onRowActivate (invalid combinations throw).
     */
    selectionMode?: SelectionMode;
    /**
     * Controlled selected IDs; when omitted, uses an empty selection. In multiselect mode, IDs outside supplied rows remain in change notifications; single mode proposes the newly selected ID. Update this set externally.
     */
    selectedItems?: ReadonlySet<DataGridRowId>;
    /**
     * Native Fluent selection notification with event and a fresh proposed selection Set.
     * Update selectedItems externally. Suppressed during loading; return values are ignored.
     * When omitted, no consumer receives selection requests; selectedItems remains authoritative.
     */
    onSelectionChange?: FluentDataGridProps['onSelectionChange'];
    /**
     * Controlled hidden column IDs; when omitted, shows every declared column and stale IDs are ignored.
     */
    hiddenColumnIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
    /**
     * Native resizing options keyed by declared column IDs. Descriptor width and
     * minWidth override matching native entries; other native options are preserved.
     * Active when resizableColumns is enabled.
     * When omitted, only declared column width/minWidth overrides and native resizing defaults are used.
     */
    columnSizingOptions?: FluentDataGridProps['columnSizingOptions'];
    /**
     * Native offset applied to measured resize container width.
     * When omitted, the native Fluent grid offset applies.
     */
    containerWidthOffset?: FluentDataGridProps['containerWidthOffset'];
    /**
     * Root Intl locale fallback; when omitted, uses the host Intl default. Column locale overrides it. Invalid Intl locales throw.
     */
    locale?: DataGridLocale;
    /**
     * Overrides selected localized strings; omitted members and blank static strings retain the host-selected native baseline. Nonblank whitespace is preserved; invalid types throw. locale governs data formatting independently.
     */
    strings?: Partial<DataGridStrings>;
    /**
     * Initial or refresh loading status. Reuses AutoSkeleton over type-aware,
     * rounded rectangle templates for every visible column and at least four rows.
     * Simulated geometry varies deterministically by row/column identity, without
     * fabricating consumer items or reading absent values. Real cell state remains
     * mounted; selection and activation are disabled until loading completes.
     * No separate loading label or progress indicator is rendered.
     * When omitted, the grid is not loading and interaction is available.
     * @defaultValue false
     */
    loading?: boolean;
    /**
     * Literal error content inside the owned MessageBarBody. Object slots use a
     * fixed inner div; refs/events target it. Block content is supported. Undefined,
     * legacy null and false omit the error bar; true requests an empty bar.
     * @example
     * ```ts
     * import { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
     * const error: DataGridProps<{ id: number }>['error'] = { children: 'Request failed', className: 'error-copy' };
     * ```
     */
    error?: ContentSlot<'div'>;
    /**
     * Called by the localized retry button when an error is displayed. When omitted, hides that button. No fetching or promise handling is performed.
     */
    onRetry?: () => void;
    /**
     * Selects the empty or no-results presentation; when omitted, selects empty. The default localized text
     * is horizontally centered with Fluent medium block padding and natural height.
     * @defaultValue 'empty'
     */
    emptyState?: 'empty' | 'noResults';
    /**
     * Custom empty input content, preserving its own presentation.
     * Can compose StateMessage for richer copy, artwork or consumer-owned actions.
     * Object slots create a fixed inner div; refs target it, not the status shell.
     * Nullish values use localized defaults; boolean/empty content suppresses text.
     * Strings are literal.
     *
     * When omitted or undefined, uses the localized strings.empty content.
     * @example
     * ```ts
     * import { DataGridProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
     * const emptyContent: DataGridProps<{ id: number }>['emptyContent'] = { children: 'No records' };
     * ```
     */
    emptyContent?: ContentSlot<'div'>;
    /**
     * Custom no-results content, preserving its own presentation.
     * Can compose StateMessage without adding search/filter behavior to the grid.
     * Fixed inner div for objects/callbacks; refs/events belong to that div.
     * Nullish values use localized defaults; boolean/empty content suppresses text.
     *
     * When omitted or undefined, uses the localized strings.noResults content.
     * @example
     * ```ts

## DataGridStrings

Localized status and cell strings. Root strings accepts partial overrides; omitted
members and blank static strings retain host-selected native resources, independently of the data locale. Nonblank static
strings retain whitespace; invalid object/member types throw. No toolkit provider is required.

### Imports (43)

```ts
import type { DataGridStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DataGridStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { DataGridStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/data-grid';
```

### Examples (126)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { DataGridStrings, createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const Grid = createDataGrid<{ id: number; title: string }>();
const rows = [{ id: 1, title: 'Plan' }];
const columns = Grid.defineColumns(c => [c.text({ id: 'title', header: 'Title', field: 'title' })]);
const strings: Partial<DataGridStrings> = { empty: 'Nessun dato', noResults: 'Nessun risultato' };
<Grid items={rows} getRowId={row => row.id} columns={columns} strings={strings} />;
```

### Type (39)

````ts
type DataGridSuite<TItem extends object> = React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<DataGridProps<TItem> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & DataGridColumnMarkers<TItem> & {
    /**
     * Synchronously calls factory with this suite's builder and returns a frozen same-suite descriptor list.
     * Foreign descriptors are rejected here; duplicate IDs are rejected when the grid resolves columns. Use the result as columns on this grid.
     * @example
     * ```ts
     * import { createDataGrid } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
     * const Grid = createDataGrid<{ id: number; title: string }>();
     * const columns = Grid.defineColumns(c => [c.text({ id: "title", header: "Title", field: "title" })]);
     * ```
     *
     * @param factory - Pure synchronous factory receiving this suite’s column builder; return only descriptors from that builder.
     * @returns Ordered immutable descriptors from this suite, validated without sorting or transforming the row data.
     */
    defineColumns: (/** Pure factory called once with this suite’s builder.
     * @param builder - Builder creating descriptors owned by this grid suite.
     * @returns Ordered same-suite descriptors; sources and callbacks remain caller-owned.
     */ factory: (builder: DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem>) => readonly DataGridColumnDefinition<TItem>[]) => readonly DataGridColumnDefinition<TItem>[];
}
````

```

### Type (40)

````ts
type DynamicDataGridSuite = React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<DataGridProps<Record<string, unknown>> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & DynamicDataGridColumnMarkers & {
    /**
     * Synchronously calls factory with the dynamic builder and returns a frozen descriptor list owned by DataGrid. Foreign descriptors are rejected here; duplicate IDs are rejected when the grid resolves columns.
     * @example

     * ```
     *
     * @param factory - Pure synchronous factory receiving this suite’s column builder; return only descriptors from that builder.
     * @returns Ordered immutable descriptors from this suite, validated without sorting or transforming the row data.
     */
    defineColumns: (/** Pure factory called once with this suite’s builder.

     */ factory: (builder: DynamicDataGridColumnBuilder) => readonly DataGridColumnDefinition<Record<string, unknown>>[]) => readonly DataGridColumnDefinition<Record<string, unknown>>[];
}
````
